description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_2d_x_zero_grad_central.esm (model Advection2DxZeroGrad, test mms_steady_x_zero_grad) at the problem's default resolution (NX=64, NY edge-bound to 8) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the second-order centered first-derivative rule central_D1x_zero_grad_bc (2nd-order one-sided x-faces) on the full 2-D field. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust terminates even at reltol 1e-9 but disagrees with the Julia reference beyond the 1e-9 cross-binding-actuals floor on one value at the weakly-non-normal one-sided boundary mode -- a solver method-disagreement floor (Erk vs Tsit5), not a discretization error; the case itself passes its inline assertions. Julia+Python gate it.
